newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - OIL REFINERY'S 1Q PRODUCTION UP.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - OIL REFINERY'S 1Q PRODUCTION UP.

text.p: Lithuania's Mazheikiu Nafta oil refinery said on Monday that its production rose considerably in the first quarter of this year compared to the same period last year.
The company said in a statement that it refined 1.127 million tonnes of oil products in the first three months of this year versus 707,471 tonnes in the same period in 1996.
The refinery added that it was only shut-down for 14 days in the first quarter of this year compared with 35 days in the corresponding period last year.
The company also said that it had refined 535,072 tonnes of its own oil products in the first three months of this year, compared to 101,693 tonnes in the first quarter of 1996.

The state-run refinery, which has been plauged by numerous financial and supply problems in the past, said that a $40 million eurobond issue in February raised the working funds needed to improve its performance.
The company refined 4.1 million tonnes of oil products last year and operated at only 34 percent of its capacity.
